title: Download page files or images
description: Save detected files or images through the DSphere file API to the user export folder first, allowing browser downloads only after that route is unavailable or fails, by fileId from the latest dsagent.page.files.detect (at most 50 per call).
guidance: Only http and https addresses download; the result lists the fileIds that did not. The result includes each confirmed saved filePath. Explicitly tell the person where the files reside; browser fallback paths include actual duplicate numbering. Requires an idempotency key: repeating a key with the same files returns the first result without downloading again.

inputSchema.description: The page and the files to download.

pageContextId.description: Opaque page context from dsagent.pages.list or dsagent.page.open.

items.description: A fileId from the latest dsagent.page.files.detect of this page.

outputSchema.description: Completed saves and their confirmed locations.

pageContextId.description: Opaque page context from dsagent.pages.list or dsagent.page.open.

savedFiles.description: Confirmed local locations; explicitly report these paths to the person.

fileId.description: A fileId from the latest dsagent.page.files.detect of this page.

filePath.description: The actual saved absolute path, including browser duplicate numbering on fallback.

destination.description: Whether the file API or browser fallback completed this save.

items.description: One file not downloaded and why.

fileId.description: A fileId from the latest dsagent.page.files.detect of this page.

reason.description: not-detected: the latest detect of the page has no such fileId (detect again); not-http: the address is not http or https.
